questions.question: How to send a photo on WhatsApp?
questions.answer:
1. Open WhatsApp 📱
2. Tap the 📷 icon in a chat
3. Choose a photo or take a new one
4. Press SEND ✔️

questions.question: How to create a WhatsApp group?
questions.answer:
1. Open WhatsApp → Tap New Group 👥
2. Select contacts → Tap Next
3. Set group name & photo → Tap Create

questions.question: How to pay via Paytm?
questions.answer:
1. Open Paytm 💰
2. Tap 'Pay' or scan QR code
3. Enter amount & UPI PIN
4. Confirmation will appear! ✅
